desc: New SsaoDiligent module: c-engine/renderer/diligent/SsaoDiligent.h/.cpp — ssaoInit(device)/ssaoDestroy() (unique_ptr<Diligent::ScreenSpaceAmbientOcclusion>, CreateInfo{EnableAsyncCreation=false}), ssaoSettingsApply(enabled, radius, algorithm, intensity) storing HLSL::ScreenSpaceAmbientOcclusionAttribs (fxh defaults: EffectRadius 1.0, EffectFalloffRange 0.615, RadiusMultiplier 1.457, TemporalStabilityFactor 0.9, SpatialReconstructionRadius 4.0, Algorithm GTAO), ssaoFrameBegin(ctx) calling PrepareResources(device, ctx, taaPostFXContext(), FEATURE_FLAG_HALF_RESOLUTION) every frame regardless of enable, ssaoExecute(ctx) building RenderAttributes (pDepthBufferSRV=taaDepthSRV(frameIdx&1), pNormalBufferSRV=taaNormalSRV(), pSSAOAttribs) returning false on PENDING, ssaoAOSRV()/ssaoReady(). Call site in TaaDiligent.cpp taaWorldResolve immediately after postFXContext->Execute (1128), wrapped in Diligent::ScopedDebugGroup{ctx,"ssao"}, gated on ssaoReady() && ssaoOn, before taa->Execute (1142). desc: AO composite pass: in TaaDiligent.cpp createTargets add aoCompositeTex (RGBA16F, TARGET size, 1:1 with sceneColorTex), released in destroyTargets; new inline PS alongside kBlitPS/kDownsamplePS/kCasPS computing out.rgb * (1.0-(1.0-ao.r)*strength) with 1:1 point sample of the AO R8 and an AoCompositeAttribs CB (strength, default 1.0, cbuffer on PRS not a static SRB slot). In taaWorldResolve, between the TAA block (1142-1145) and the renderScale downsample (1155-1163) after the ENGINE_TAA_DEBUG_MV swap (debug-MV path stays AO-free): when ssaoOn && ssaoAOSRV(), run composite srcColorSRV -> aoCompositeTex sampling the AO SRV, then point srcColorSRV at aoCompositeTex SRV for the downsample/CAS/blit. DiligentRenderer.cpp:801-804 applyGraphicsSettings: forward g.ssao + radius/algorithm/intensity into ssaoSettingsApply.
result: aoCompositeTex (RGBA16F, target-size) + inline kAoCompositePS (1:1 point sample of R8 AO, STATIC cbuffer on PSO via MapHelper, strength=ssaoIntensity) in TaaDiligent; composite runs between the TAA block and the downsample gated on ssaoRan (the ssaoExecute return — the correct AO-valid-this-frame signal, since the AO SRV is uncleared and undefined when Execute didn't run), then srcColorSRV -> aoCompositeTex feeds downsample/CAS/blit; applyGraphicsSettings forwards ssaoSettingsApply(s.ssao,1.0f,0,1.0f). A/B screenshots: 97% of changed pixels darker with AO on, contact darkening, sky unchanged, no mis-registration at scale 2.0; TAA-off control identical; ~0.4ms added. Clean build.
